title: Rat ACTB one-step qPCR
author: Daniel Groelz
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qnidvce

steps.title: Tissue Collection and Fixation
steps.instruction: Collect rat tissues (Liver, Kidney, Spleen, Intestine, Lung) no larger than 15 × 15 × 4 mm within 5 min of sacrifice by CO2 asphyxiation.

substeps.instruction: For snap-frozen samples: Snap freeze in liquid nitrogen, transport on dry ice, and store at -80°C.
For NBF fixation: Submerge in neutral buffered formalin (Merck KGaA) at a ratio of at least 20:1 (v/v) for 24 hours at room temperature.
For PAXgene fixation: Fix in PAXgene Tissue Fix (PreAnalytiX Gmbh) for 2-4 hours at room temperature, then transfer to PAXgene Tissue Stabilizer for 24-72 hours at room temperature.

steps.title: Tissue Processing and Embedding
steps.instruction: Process formalin or PAXgene fixed tissues using an automated tissue processor (TP1020 Leica-microsystems).

substeps.instruction: Incubate in 80%, 90%, 99% ethanol (2x), isopropanol (2x), and xylene (2x) for no longer than 1h at each position.
Infiltrate with Surgipath Paraplast-XTRA (Carl Roth GmbH) low-melting point paraffin by incubating 3 x 1 h under vacuum at 56°C.
Embed samples within 30 min after infiltration.

steps.title: Sample Storage
steps.instruction: Store processed blocks and cryo-preserved tissues according to the required temperature.

substeps.instruction: Store PFPE and FFPE blocks in the dark at 22°C, 4°C, -20°C, or -80°C.
Store cryo-preserved tissue for up to one year at -80°C.

steps.title: DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract DNA in triplicate based on the tissue type.

substeps.instruction: Cryo: Use 20 mg of frozen tissue with DNeasy Tissue kit (QIAGEN); elute in 100µl Buffer AE.
FFPE: Use three 10 µm thick sections with QIAamp FFPE kit (QIAGEN); elute in 40µl Buffer AE.
PFPE: Use three 10 µm thick sections with PAXgene Tissue DNA kit (PreAnalytiX Gmbh); elute in 40µl Buffer TD5.

steps.title: DNA Quality Analysis
steps.instruction: Determine DNA purity, yield, and integrity.

substeps.instruction: Measure purity and yield via spectrophotometric absorbance at 260nm using Nanodrop ND-1000.
Confirm yield with Qubit 2.0 Fluorometer using Qubit dsDNA Assay.
Assess integrity on Agilent 4200 TapeStation system with genomic DNA Analysis ScreenTape assay.

steps.title: Primer Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare rat beta-actin (NC_005111) specific primers from lyophilized, HPLC-purified stocks (Metabion GmbH).

substeps.instruction: Dissolve oligonucleotides to 100 µM stock solution.
Store stocks at -15°C to -30°C.
Prepare working solutions at 10µM.

steps.title: qPCR Reaction Setup
steps.instruction: Prepare the reaction mix in 0.1mL Rotorgene 72-Well Rotor Strip Tubes and Caps (QIAGEN).

substeps.instruction: Add 10ng DNA.
Add 10µl 2x Quantitect SYBR Green Master Mix.
Add 1µl forward primer (10µM working solution) to reach 0.5µM final concentration.
Add 1µl reverse primer (10µM working solution) to reach 0.5µM final concentration.
Add water to reach a final volume of 20µl.

steps.title: qPCR Thermal Cycling
steps.instruction: Run the amplification on a Rotor-Gene Q series II (QIAGEN) using Rotor Gene Q Series Software 2.3.1.

substeps.instruction: Hold Stage: 95°C for 15 min (1 cycle).
PCR Stage: 94°C for 15 sec, 60°C for 30 sec, and 70°C for 30 sec (40 cycles).
Melt Curve Stage: 95°C for 15 sec, 60°C for 30 sec, 95°C for 15 sec (1 cycle).

steps.title: Validation and Data Analysis
steps.instruction: Validate the qPCR results based on specificity and run validity.

substeps.instruction: Examine amplicon length (271, 523, 650, or 747 bp) via agarose gel electrophoresis.
Perform melting curve analysis to ensure no extraneous peaks or non-specific amplification.
Verify no-template controls (NTC) show no amplifiable product (no Ct).
Accept reactions only if Ct < 40 and melting curves are valid.
